Firms including Chevron, ONGC, GE Vernova on track to sign final pacts in Venezuela, sources say
items.summary: HOUSTON/CARACAS, Aug 31 (Reuters) - U. companies Chevron and GE Vernova, India's ONGC, Italy's Eni and Colombia's GeoPark are on track to sign final agreements in Venezuela after months of negotiations to ‌firm up energy projects in the OPEC country, five sources close to the preparations said.

items.title: Venezuela’s Energy Reopening Could Benefit Chevron (CVX) and GE Vernova (GEV), But Risks Remain
items.summary: Chevron Corporation (NYSE:CVX), GE Vernova Inc.
